summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload on npm install
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) for the host's platform and architecture from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and then invokes that Bun binary against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with rotated string-array obfuscation, a string-array decoder function, and randomized identifiers, whose contents are opaque without running the Bun decoder. The bundle bears no relation to the package's advertised Knockout/React bridge purpose, and its file name (math_init.js) does not describe its contents. The result is that every `npm install` of this version fetches an alternate language runtime for the sole purpose of executing an opaque, obfuscated payload on the installer's machine, with no integrity check on the payload and no relationship between what is executed and the package's stated function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
